content.comentariu: În luna octombrie HR a cheltuit 50.594 RON, depășind bugetul de 50.000 RON cu 594 RON (+1,19%). Cheltuielile maverick totalizează 12.348 RON, toate în categoria TRN.
content.actiune: Revizuiește procedura de aprobare și monitorizează cheltuielile maverick în categoria TRN.

reasoning:
We need to produce JSON with comment, causes, alert level, action.

Data: variance pct = 1.19% absolute value 1.19 <= verde_max_pct 5 => initial alert Verde. Since maverick_ron >0 (12348) and initial is Verde, alert becomes Galben.

Now comment: 2-3 sentences about situation. Use values rounded to integer RON with thousand separator. buget 50.000 RON, realizat 50.594 RON, variance +594 RON (+1,19%). Maverick 12.348 RON (category TRN). Provide concise.

Causes: need categories that explain direction of total variance (positive, i.e., over budget). So look at categories where realizat > buget.

Compute differences:

TRN: buget 12.000, realizat 12.348 => +348 RON over buget (but note all maverick). SRV: buget 20.000, realizat 20.600 => +600 RON over. SW: buget 12.000, realizat 11.496 => -504 (under). BIR: buget 6.000, realizat 6.150 => +150 over.

Total overbudget contributions: TRN +348, SRV +600, BIR +150 = +1,098. Underbudget SW -504. Net +594 matches variance.

We need list 1-3 short strings, ordered by magnitude of difference (absolute) that explain direction (over). So biggest positive differences: SRV +600, TRN +348, BIR +150. Could include up to 3. Provide as strings like "SRV: +600 RON peste buget", "TRN: +348 RON peste buget (maverick)", "BIR: +150 RON peste buget". Might include note about maverick.

We must not exceed 3 items. Provide 3.

Action: single recommendation, e.g., "Revizuiește procedura de aprobare și monitorizează cheltuielile maverick în categoria TRN". Provide in Romanian.

Now format JSON compact, keys in order as required? Not required but include exactly those keys.

Make sure numbers formatted with thousand separator and comma for decimals? For comment we need to embed numbers as text with formatting. Use RON integer with dot as thousand separator: 50.000 RON, 50.594 RON, 12.348 RON, etc.

Now produce JSON.
